runners.name: Chartered
runners.comment: CHARTERED was fractious in the gate then got away alertly and opened up on the lead before being roused at the top of the stretch and responded well, drawing clear in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Can't Stop Willis
runners.comment: CAN'T STOP WILLIS settled early along the rail then waited into the turn before angling out into the stretch and split horses while rallying late for place.

runners.name: Castle Run
runners.comment: CASTLE RUN rated in the second flight early with a rail trip then drifted out nearing the 1/8 pole before being caught late for place.

runners.name: Telecaster
runners.comment: TELECASTER bobbled at the start then stalked the early pace before drifting out at the 1/4 pole and made a bid between horses in the stretch but was outfinished.

runners.name: He Has Game
runners.comment: HE HAS GAME reared at the start then rated in the middle of the pack with a five wide trip before being asked into the stretch but made no rally.

runners.name: Doc Graham
runners.comment: DOC GRAHAM rated in the middle of the pack early and saved ground into the turn then angled six wide into the stretch and made a bid but faltered.

runners.name: Ravin's Ransom
runners.comment: RAVIN'S RANSOM chased the pace while four wide then loomed to challenge at the 1/4 pole and raced all out through the stretch run, prevailing at the wire.

runners.name: Gardiner
runners.comment: GARDINER was rushed up along the inside and set the early pace then battled through the turn before drifting out into the stretch and contesting the long drive with RAVIN'S RANSOM before running on while second best.

runners.name: Mister Banderas
runners.comment: MISTER BANDERAS rated in the middle of the pack early then angled six wide into the stretch and was gaining late, closing the gap on the leaders in the final sixteenth.

runners.name: Eli's Promise
runners.comment: ELI'S PROMISE broke outward the rated in the second flight early while chasing the pace through the turn before making a bid along the rail in the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: Charge for Gold
runners.comment: CHARGE FOR GOLD stumbled at the start and showed no speed early then angled six wide into the lane and made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Halloween
runners.comment: HALLOWEEN was allowed to settle early and saved ground then was urged along the rail into the stretch but made no rally late.

runners.name: Decatur Street
runners.comment: DECATUR STREET got away alertly and pressed the early pace then showed speed for a half mile before fading in the stretch.

runners.name: Executive Chef
runners.comment: EXECUTIVE CHEF broke outward then got squeezed back at the start and lost contact with the field while never factoring.

runners.name: Grande Sorpreso
runners.comment: GRANDE SORPRESO got away alertly and set the early pace then was roused and responded in the lane, holding sway at the wire.

runners.name: Rocky Raccoon
runners.comment: ROCKY RACCOON settled early then made a steady advance on the turn and a four wide bid into the stretch, racing all out while second best.

runners.name: Union Cait
runners.comment: UNION CAIT was void of early speed then angled six wide into the stretch and was asked, closing willingly late.

runners.name: S S Quality
runners.comment: S S QUALITY was allowed to settle early then angled four wide and made a bid between horses into the stretch and a mild rally late.

runners.name: Countthecarats
runners.comment: COUNTTHECARATS broke outward then pressed the early pace and chased for a half mile before giving way.

runners.name: Dr. Park
runners.comment: DR. PARK rated in the second flight and saved ground then made a bid along the rail but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: Fan's Choice
runners.comment: FAN'S CHOICE raced close up early and saved ground then made a bid along the rail into the stretch, racing all out and drew clear late.

runners.name: Livelaughloy
runners.comment: LIVELAUGHLOY was void of early speed with a rail trip then split horses in the stretch and was full of run, getting up late for place.

runners.name: Resilient Lady
runners.comment: RESILIENT LADY took up at the start then rated in the second flight early before looming to challenge at the 1/4 pole and took a lead into the stretch before racing erratically nearing the 1/8 pole then was caught late for place.

runners.name: First Ladybug
runners.comment: FIRST LADYBUG broke sharply then settled off the pace while tucking in to save ground into the turn then altered seven wide at the top of the stretch and was gaining late.

runners.name: It All Makes Cents
runners.comment: IT ALL MAKES CENTS rated in the second flight early and chased the pace then waited through the turn before being asked in the stretch and made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Ardennes
runners.comment: ARDENNES rated in the middle of the pack with a five wide trip then was urged nearing the 3/8 pole before being brushed by DAMA DIAMANTE nearing the 1/8 pole then raced evenly in the stretch.

runners.name: Lucky Dial
runners.comment: LUCKY DIAL got away alertly and set the early pace while pressed on the lead then gave way in the stretch.

runners.name: Dama Diamante
runners.comment: DAMA DIAMANTE broke sharply and pressed the early pace, contending to the top of the stretch before brushing ARDENNES nearing the 1/8 pole then gave way.

runners.name: Maker Run
runners.comment: MAKER RUN got squeezed at the start then settled in the second flight early while saving ground into the turn then made a bid along the rail but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: A Sip of Vino
runners.comment: A SIP OF VINO got squeezed at the start then rated in the middle of the pack early before dropping back into the turn then never threatened.

runners.name: Impavido
runners.comment: IMPAVIDO raced close up and pressed the early pace then loomed to challenge at the 3/8 pole and raced all out through the stretch, holding sway on the wire.

runners.name: Legitimate
runners.comment: LEGITIMATE broke inward then moved up and set the early pace before being headed into the stretch but dug in, running on to be second best.

runners.name: Dispersion
runners.comment: DISPERSION moved up and chased the early pace then made a bid between horses into the stretch and was gaining late.

runners.name: My King Air
runners.comment: MY KING AIR got crowded at the start then rated in the second flight and saved ground through the turn before angling six wide into the stretch and making a mild rally late.

runners.name: Equilibrium
runners.comment: EQUILIBRIUM stumbled badly at the start and dropped back early then raced with a rail trip and made a belated bid late.

runners.name: Pezzonovante
runners.comment: PEZZONOVANTE got crowded at the start and dropped back to the back of the field while racing off the rail before being urged while six wide through the turn then split horses in the stretch and made a late rally.

runners.name: Senor Valentine
runners.comment: SENOR VALENTINE was allowed to settle early and saved ground before being asked into the stretch but just raced evenly late.

runners.name: Triple Max
runners.comment: TRIPLE MAX got crowded at the start then rated in the middle of the pack early before altered four wide into the stretch and made a bid but faltered.

runners.name: Coal Fired
runners.comment: COAL FIRED stalked the pace while three wide and chased through the opening half, flashing brief foot before fading.

runners.name: Aubrey's Max
runners.comment: AUBREY'S MAX rated in the middle of the pack early before being urged nearing the 3/8 pole and made a brief bid but flattened out in the stretch.

runners.name: She's On a Roll
runners.comment: SHE'S ON A ROLL rated in the middle of the pack early while tucking in to save ground before angling six wide at the top of the stretch and rallied while lugging in through the stretch run then got up in time.

runners.name: Ageeba Beach
runners.comment: AGEEBA BEACH was void of early speed then waited behind horsed through the second turn before lacking room nearing the 1/8 pole then was able to split horses at the 1/16 pole and rallied late for place.

runners.name: Eat Hay Run
runners.comment: EAT HAY RUN stalked the early pace then loomed to challenge at the 3/8 pole and made a bid, leading late into the stretch before getting caught.

runners.name: Determined Ace
runners.comment: DETERMINED ACE was allowed to settle early and tucked in into the second turn before altering seven wide at the top of the stretch and closed willingly.

runners.name: Just Entitled
runners.comment: JUST ENTITLED rated in the second flight early then made a bid between horses into the stretch before being in tight nearing the 1/16 pole when SHE's ON A ROLL lugged in then gave way late.

runners.name: Take the Helm
runners.comment: TAKE THE HELM raced close up early with a rail trip then angled out into the stretch and made a bid between horses but faltered.

runners.name: Ghost Sense
runners.comment: GHOST SENSE got away alertly and set the early pace then was headed nearing the 1/4 pole and faded in the stretch.

runners.name: Interview
runners.comment: INTERVIEW got squeezed at the start then rated in the middle of the pack with a five wide trip before being asked on the turn but made no rally.

runners.name: She's Our Ten
runners.comment: SHE'S OUR TEN was rank and rushed from the gate then bore out on the first turn before dropping back on the backstretch run and trailed the field.

runners.name: Tiger Baby
runners.comment: TIGER BABY was allowed to settle early then circled while six wide on the turn and made a quick move to take the lead into the stretch before drawing off.

runners.name: Maranello
runners.comment: MARANELLO raced close up and pressed the early pace then loomed to contend at the 1/4 pole and made a bid before running on while second best.

runners.name: Black Market
runners.comment: BLACK MARKET was fractious in the gate then rated in the second flight early before being steadied nearing the 1/2 pole then made a rail bid into the stretch and rallied late.

runners.name: Never Odd Or Even
runners.comment: NEVER ODD OR EVEN was allowed to settle early and tucked in before being shuffled back nearing the 1/2 pole but chose to remain on the inside and made a bid along the rail into the stretch and was gaining late.

runners.name: Ice Empress
runners.comment: ICE EMPRESS raced close up early and saved ground into the turn before angling four wide into the stretch and was asked, making a mild rally late.

runners.name: Dialed
runners.comment: DIALED was allowed to settle early and saved ground then angled out into the stretch and made a bid between horses, racing evenly late.

runners.name: Getaway Girl
runners.comment: GETAWAY GIRL chased the pace while five wide and contended through the turn before getting out in the stretch then faded late.

runners.name: Life On Marz
runners.comment: LIFE ON MARZ was void of speed while racing five wide early then tucked in into the stretch but made no rally late.

runners.name: Simply Elegant
runners.comment: SIMPLY ELEGANT got away alertly and set the pace before being headed on the turn then dropped back and came up empty in the stretch.

runners.name: Candy Illusion
runners.comment: CANDY ILLUSION stalked the early pace between horses before taking back into the turn then altered seven wide into the stretch but made no rally.

runners.name: After the Storm
runners.comment: AFTER THE STORM stalked the early pace and chased between horses, flashing brief foot before fading.

runners.name: Tagermeen
runners.comment: TAGERMEEN got away alertly and raced close up then altered four wide into the turn and made a move to contend before being roused into the stretch and drew off.

runners.name: Dr Ruben M
runners.comment: DR RUBEN M was allowed to settle early then circled six wide on the turn and sustained the bid through the stretch to get up for place.

runners.name: Eagles Flight
runners.comment: EAGLES FLIGHT rated in the second flight early then made a bid between horses into the stretch before being headed but came again and ran on for show.

runners.name: Market Street
runners.comment: MARKET STREET got off slowly and saved ground then angled seven wide into the stretch and gained belatedly.

runners.name: Jefferson Street
runners.comment: JEFFERSON STREET got squeezed at the start then rated in the second flight with a four wide trip and made a bid in the stretch but was outfinished.

runners.name: Stiglets
runners.comment: STIGLETS broke inward then pressed the early pace and made a bid between horses but faltered in the stretch.

runners.name: It's My Life
runners.comment: IT'S MY LIFE rated in the second flight early then took back before being urged near the 3/8 pole then angled eight wide into the stretch but was no factor.

runners.name: Master Controller
runners.comment: MASTER CONTROLLER was rushed up and set the early pace while pressed on the lead then was headed in the turn and gave way in the stretch.

runners.name: Fashion Influencer
runners.comment: FASHION INFLUENCER got away alertly and set the pace while well rated on the lead then was roused into the stretch and opened up before drifting out late but held sway on the wire.

runners.name: Bush League
runners.comment: BUSH LEAGUE rated in the second flight early and chased the pace then angled five wide into the stretch and rallied late for place.

runners.name: Wangshu
runners.comment: WANGSHU raced close up with a rail trip then angled out into the stretch and was all out, running on late.

runners.name: My My My Delilah
runners.comment: MY MY MY DELILAH rated in the middle of the pack early then waited through the turn before splitting horses into the stretch and closed willingly.

runners.name: Riyah Al Nil
runners.comment: RIYAH AL NIL rated in the second flight early then steadied nearing the 1/2 pole before being urged while six wide nearing the 1/4 pole and made a mild rally late.

runners.name: Risky Wave
runners.comment: RISKY WAVE chased the pace while five wide then loomed to contend nearing the 3/8 pole and made a bid but flattened out.

runners.name: Preach Tewmey Now
runners.comment: PREACH TEWMEY NOW got squeezed at the start then was void of speed while racing along the inside before being in tight and steadying nearing the 1/2 pole then dropped back and never factored.

runners.name: Muriel Sax
runners.comment: MURIEL SAX was fractious in the gate then was allowed to settle with a five wide trip and made a bid but faltered.

runners.name: Shidoni
runners.comment: SHIDONI showed no speed and tucked in early then angled six wide into the stretch and passed tiring rivals.

runners.name: Diamond Tiara
runners.comment: DIAMOND TIARA rated in the second flight early and flashed brief foot before dropping back on the turn then made no rally.

runners.name: Action Player
runners.comment: ACTION PLAYER rated in the middle of the pack then steadied nearing the 5/16 pole and faded before falling just after the wire then got up and was vanned off in the equine ambulance.

runners.name: Lola's Fine
runners.comment: LOLA'S FINE moved up and pressed the early pace, flashing brief foot, but faded. THE RIDER OF PREACH TEWMEY NOW CLAIMED FOUL AGAINST THE RIDER OF MY MY MY DELILAH ALLEGING INTERFERENCE IN THE TURN. NO CHANGE WAS MADE.
